nodes.label: The Defence Ecosystem
nodes.does: The whole system, from strategy to the front line.

nodes.label: Strategy & Policy
nodes.does: Sets direction, budget and the demand signal.

nodes.label: Secretary of State for Defence
nodes.does: Political head of the MOD; owns SDR 2025 and the direction the whole system follows.

nodes.label: Defence Reform (four-pillar model)
nodes.does: Re-aligned the MOD into Department of State, Military Strategic HQ, the NAD Group and the Defence Nuclear Enterprise.

nodes.label: Strategic Defence Review 2025
nodes.does: The root strategy — sets the threat picture, force design and the push for novel tech and faster procurement.

nodes.label: Defence Industrial Strategy 2025
nodes.does: ‘Making defence an engine for growth’ — industrial, SME, exports, skills and clusters agenda.

nodes.label: Military Strategic HQ
nodes.does: CDS-led; owns military strategy and the capability requirement that pulls innovation through.

nodes.label: Development, Concepts & Doctrine Centre (DCDC)
nodes.does: MOD's think tank — future concepts, doctrine and the Global Strategic Trends horizon-scan.

nodes.label: MOD Head Office
nodes.does: Department of State — policy, finance and corporate direction.

nodes.label: Acquisition & Commercial — NAD Group
nodes.does: The consolidated procurement engine.

nodes.label: National Armaments Director & NAD Group
nodes.does: National Armaments Director (Rupert Pearce, from Oct 2025) leads the NAD Group, established March 2025; it unites the MOD's enabling organisations under nine National Armaments areas and a single consolidated investment budget, delivering the DIS and Defence Investment Plan.

nodes.label: Defence Equipment & Support (DE&S)
nodes.entry: des.mod.uk · 0117 913 0893 · MOD Abbey Wood, Bristol BS34 8JH
nodes.does: MOD's main procurement & support arm (700+ programmes) across ships, land, air and weapons; its materiel core now forms National Armaments Materiel (NA-M).
nodes.oppsOverride: Tenders via the Defence Sourcing Portal (Jaggaer) and Find a Tender (www.find-tender.service.gov.uk).

nodes.label: DE&S Future Capability Group (FCG)
nodes.does: Robotics, autonomy and rapid capability; a core member of the Defence AI Centre federation.
nodes.oppsOverride: Robotics and autonomy calls routed via UKDI/DASA competitions and DE&S tenders (www.find-tender.service.gov.uk).

nodes.label: Defence Digital
nodes.does: MOD digital backbone, networks, data and enterprise IT; now National Armaments Digital & Data (NA-D&D).

nodes.label: Defence Infrastructure Organisation (DIO)
nodes.does: Manages the defence estate, ranges and infrastructure used for trials and experimentation; its armaments-infrastructure function is National Armaments Infrastructure within the NAD Group.

nodes.label: Defence Commercial / Sourcing Portal
nodes.does: MOD's commercial function and the portal where contracts and tenders are advertised; now within National Armaments Commercial & Industry (NA-C&I).
nodes.oppsOverride: MOD requirements advertised on the Defence Sourcing Portal and Find a Tender (www.find-tender.service.gov.uk).

nodes.label: Single Source Regulations Office (SSRO)
nodes.does: Regulates non-competitive contracts >£5m; sets the Baseline Profit Rate (9.10% for 2026/27).

nodes.label: Crown Commercial Service (CCS)
nodes.does: Cross-government commercial agreements used for common goods and services, incl. defence.

nodes.label: Science, Technology & Innovation
nodes.does: Where new capability is found, funded and de-risked.

nodes.label: Dstl
nodes.does: MOD in-house S&T authority — research, experimentation and technical assurance; now within National Armaments Innovation (NA-Innov). Parent of DASA (now part of UKDI).
nodes.oppsOverride: Research opportunities via the Serapis framework and R-Cloud; tenders on Contracts Finder (www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk).

nodes.label: UK Defence Innovation (UKDI)
nodes.entry: Single front door · GOV.UK submission service
nodes.does: The MOD's consolidated defence-innovation body (£400m/yr; ~£1.6bn in the DIP); now the NAD Group's National Armaments Innovation area alongside Dstl, having absorbed the Defence & Security Accelerator (DASA).
nodes.oppsOverride: UKDI competitions — including the multi-cycle ‘Innovation Support to Operations’ themed competition (fast, TRL 6+, months not years) plus wider themed and loan routes. Live cycles and the five innovation themes appear on gov.uk and the UKDI submission service.
nodes.funding: Funds directly. The UK Defence Innovation front door channels problem-holders to funded competitions and pipelines; award sizes vary by route.

nodes.label: Defence & Security Accelerator (DASA)
nodes.entry: GOV.UK › DASA · accelerator@dstl.gov.uk · online submission service
nodes.does: The MOD's fast innovation 'front door' and SME competition route; now part of UK Defence Innovation (UKDI) within National Armaments Innovation (NA-Innov).
nodes.oppsOverride: DASA finds and funds exploitable innovation through themed and open competitions; now part of UKDI and running its cycles. Current competitions are listed on gov.uk (search ‘DASA’ or ‘UKDI competitions’). Contact accelerator@dstl.gov.uk.
nodes.funding: Funds directly. Runs themed and open competitions; typical DASA contracts run from tens of thousands up to a few million pounds per project, paid as R&D contracts (not grants or equity).

nodes.label: Croatia — Armed Forces of Croatia

nodes.label: Croatia — Military Security and Intelligence Agency (VSOA)

nodes.label: Croatia — Security and Intelligence Agency (SOA)

nodes.label: Croatia — Agencija Alan

nodes.label: Croatia — Dr. Franjo Tuđman Defence and Security University

nodes.label: Croatia — Brodarski Institute

nodes.label: Croatia — Brodosplit

nodes.label: Croatia — Čateks
nodes.does: Manufacturer of technical and protective textiles — camouflage, NBC-protective and specialised military clothing materials.

nodes.label: Czechia — Czech Armed Forces (Army of the Czech Republic)

nodes.label: Czechia — Military Intelligence (Vojenské zpravodajství, VZ)

nodes.label: Czechia — National Cyber and Information Security Agency (NÚKIB)

nodes.label: Czechia — STV Group

nodes.label: Czechia — Omnipol

nodes.label: Czechia — Meopta
nodes.does: Czech optical, opto-mechanical and optoelectronic manufacturer; sights, targeting optics and precision assemblies for military weapon and aerospace systems.

nodes.label: Czechia — Explosia

nodes.label: Czechia — Primoco UAV
nodes.does: Czech manufacturer of the One 150 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle for ISR and surveillance; Prague-listed with 200+ aircraft built for civil and military use.

nodes.label: Denmark — Danish Armed Forces (Forsvaret)

nodes.label: Denmark — Danish Defence Intelligence Service (FE)
nodes.does: Denmark's foreign and military intelligence service; SIGINT, defence intelligence and the national cyber-security authority, publishes annual threat assessments.

nodes.label: Denmark — Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET)
nodes.does: Denmark's civilian security and domestic intelligence service; counter-espionage, counter-terrorism and protective security.

nodes.label: Denmark — Centre for Cyber Security (CFCS)
nodes.does: Denmark's national IT security authority within the Defence Intelligence Service; network monitoring, incident response and cyber-threat assessment for critical infrastructure.

nodes.label: Denmark — Royal Danish Defence College (FAK)

nodes.label: Denmark — SH Defence

nodes.label: Denmark — Sky-Watch

nodes.label: Denmark — QuadSAT
nodes.does: Odense-based defence-tech firm using drones to test and calibrate satellite antennas and RF systems in the field for space and defence users.

nodes.label: Estonia — Estonian Defence Forces (EDF)

nodes.label: Estonia — Estonian Defence League (Kaitseliit)
nodes.does: Estonia's voluntary, militarily-organised national-defence organisation (~30,000 members); territorial defence, resilience and the Cyber Defence Unit.

nodes.label: Estonia — Estonian Foreign Intelligence Service (EFIS / Välisluureamet)

nodes.label: Estonia — Military Intelligence Centre (Kaitseväe luurekeskus)

nodes.label: Estonia — Baltic Defence College (BALTDEFCOL)

nodes.label: Finland — Finnish Defence Forces (Puolustusvoimat)

nodes.label: Finland — Finnish Defence Intelligence Agency (PVTIEDL)
nodes.does: Finland's military intelligence agency within Defence Command; combined SIGINT, GEOINT and IMINT supporting national defence and NATO situational awareness.

nodes.label: Finland — Finnish Security and Intelligence Service (SUPO)
nodes.does: Finland's civilian security and intelligence service; counter-intelligence, counter-terrorism and civilian foreign intelligence, under the Ministry of the Interior.

nodes.label: Finland — National Defence University (MPKK)

nodes.label: Finland — DEFINE (Defence Innovation Network Finland)

nodes.label: Finland — Sisu Defence

nodes.label: Finland — ICEYE

nodes.label: Finland — Summa Defence

nodes.label: France — French Armed Forces (Armées françaises)

nodes.label: France — DGSE (General Directorate for External Security)
nodes.does: France's external intelligence service under the Ministry of the Armed Forces; foreign human and technical intelligence, SIGINT and special operations, ~7,000 staff.

nodes.label: France — DRM (Directorate of Military Intelligence)

nodes.label: France — DRSD (Defence Intelligence and Security Directorate)

nodes.label: France — DGSI (General Directorate for Internal Security)
nodes.does: France's domestic intelligence and security service under the Ministry of the Interior; counter-terrorism, counter-espionage, cyber and counter-interference.

nodes.label: France — École de Guerre / IHEDN
nodes.does: France's senior joint war college (École de Guerre) and the Institute of Advanced National Defence Studies (IHEDN); strategic education and defence-and-security research for military and civilian leaders.

nodes.label: Germany — Bundeswehr (German Armed Forces)

nodes.label: Germany — Federal Intelligence Service (BND)
nodes.does: Germany's foreign intelligence service (~6,500 staff, Berlin); all-domain foreign political, economic and military intelligence via HUMINT, SIGINT and GEOINT.

nodes.label: Germany — Military Counterintelligence Service (MAD)
nodes.does: Germany's military counter-intelligence agency (Cologne); protects the Bundeswehr against espionage, sabotage and extremism, and vets personnel.

nodes.label: Germany — Federal Office for the Protection of the Constitution (BfV)
nodes.does: Germany's domestic intelligence and security service; counter-espionage, counter-terrorism, counter-extremism and detection of hostile influence operations.

nodes.label: Germany — Federal Office for Information Security (BSI)
nodes.does: Germany's national cyber-security authority; protection of federal networks and critical infrastructure, standards, certification and the national CERT-Bund.

nodes.label: Germany — Führungsakademie der Bundeswehr
nodes.does: Germany's General Staff and Command College (Hamburg, est. 1957); senior joint officer education, command and strategy, and defence-and-security research.

nodes.label: Germany — Universität der Bundeswehr
nodes.does: Germany's two Bundeswehr universities (Munich and Hamburg); officer higher education and defence research in engineering, cyber, AI and security studies, host to the dtec.bw research centre.

nodes.label: Greece — Hellenic Armed Forces (GEETHA)

nodes.label: Greece — National Intelligence Service (EYP)
nodes.does: Greece's national intelligence agency; intelligence gathering, counter-intelligence and protection of sensitive state communications.

nodes.label: Greece — Hellenic Army Academy (Evelpidon)

nodes.label: Greece — Hellenic National Defence College (SETHA)

nodes.label: Greece — ONEX Neorion Shipyards

nodes.label: Greece — METLEN M Technologies (Defence)

nodes.label: Greece — Miltech Hellas

nodes.label: Greece — Scytalys

nodes.label: Greece — Spirit Aeronautical Systems (SAS)

nodes.label: Greece — OHB Hellas
nodes.does: Greek space company; high-performance satellite data processing, optical space systems and additive manufacturing for space and defence.

nodes.label: Hungary — Hungarian Defence Forces (HDF)

nodes.label: Hungary — Defence Procurement Agency (VBÜ)

nodes.label: Iceland — Ministry for Foreign Affairs (defence & security policy)

nodes.label: India — Indian Armed Forces

nodes.label: India — Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)

nodes.label: India — Department of Defence Production (DDP)

nodes.label: India — National Technical Research Organisation (NTRO)

nodes.label: India — Defence Cyber Agency (DCyA)

nodes.label: India — Defence Space Agency (DSA)

nodes.label: India — Strategic Forces Command (SFC)

nodes.label: India — National Defence College (NDC)

nodes.label: India — Manohar Parrikar Institute for Defence Studies and Analyses (MP-IDSA)

nodes.label: India — Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders (MDL)

nodes.label: India — Tata Advanced Systems (TASL)

nodes.label: Israel — Israel Defense Forces (IDF)

nodes.label: Israel — Israel Security Agency (Shin Bet / Shabak)

nodes.label: Israel — Israel National Cyber Directorate (INCD)

nodes.label: Israel — Technion – Israel Institute of Technology

nodes.label: Israel — IDF Directorate for AI and Autonomy

nodes.label: Israel — Regulus Cyber

nodes.label: Italy — Italian Armed Forces (Difesa)

nodes.label: Italy — External Intelligence and Security Agency (AISE)

nodes.label: Italy — Internal Intelligence and Security Agency (AISI)

nodes.label: Italy — National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN)

nodes.label: Italy — Italian Space Agency (ASI)

nodes.label: Italy — Alpi Aviation

nodes.label: Italy — Stratobotic

nodes.label: Japan — Japan Self-Defense Forces (JSDF)

nodes.label: Japan — National Institute for Defense Studies (NIDS)

nodes.label: Japan — National Defense Academy of Japan (NDA)
